speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me assess your symptoms, could you please tell me how many weeks pregnant you are? Also, have you experienced any recent travel or exposure to mosquitoes?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any rash, joint pain, or sensitivity to light accompanying these symptoms? I also need to know if you have been taking any new medications or supplements recently.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the consumption of unpasteurized dairy products, I need to check for signs of Listeriosis. Have you experienced any gastrointestinal symptoms like diarrhea, nausea, or vomiting? Also, have you noticed any decreased fetal movement or abdominal pain?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Unremarkable. The patient is currently pregnant, at her 30th week of gestation. Social history: Non-smoker, does not consume alcohol. No recent travels or contact with sick individuals. No known allergies.

speaker: Doctor
text: I need to assess your neurological status, so please tell me if you have any neck stiffness or sensitivity to light. Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your urination frequency or any pain when urinating?

speaker: Patient
text: Denies cough, shortness of breath, abdominal pain, diarrhea, or urinary symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal lumbar puncture rules out meningitis, confirming this is likely listeriosis confined to the bloodstream. I will now prescribe appropriate antibiotics to treat the infection and ensure the safety of both you and your baby. DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis
